title: sedum fasciculare
intro: Sedum fasciculare, commonly known as Golden Sedum or Golden Jelly Bean, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. The health benefits of Sedum fasciculare include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing, as well as its antimicrobial properties which can help fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help protect against various diseases. Bioactive constituents present in Sedum fasciculare include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
